task.description:
Run all PD-08 tests and produce a structured test report.

### Commands to run

```bash
zig build test
zig build test-integration   # requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL
```

All tests must pass. If any test fails, report FAIL with full error output in `result.issues`.

### Report location

Write the test run report to `tests/reports/WF02-pd08-20260521-run-01.md`.

Report format (use the same format as the most recent test report in `tests/reports/`):
- Run ID, date, requirement IDs tested
- Summary table: test name | result | duration
- Full output for any failing tests
- Pass/fail verdict

### Acceptance gate

All TC-PD-08-01 through TC-PD-08-07 must PASS. Any failure must be reported in `result.issues` with severity, test name, and error output.
